verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly reference realtime capabilities for databases (broadcasting online/typing/viewing status, 'managed APIs with permissions and realtime', and 'respond to server events in realtime'), indicating a live-subscription mechanism for UI updates without polling. missing for 10: no first-party API/SDK code example for subscribing to database document changes, and no independent/hands-on verification of the realtime channel actually pushing updates.
